dog.description_text:
Meet Christmas Tree!

Sometimes, saying goodbye is one of the hardest acts of love. Christmas Tree came to us after her beloved owner became ill and was no longer able to give her the care she deserves. He was heartbroken to make the decision, but knew finding her a new home was the best thing for his girl. Now, we're determined to make sure Christmas Tree's next chapter is everything she deserves.

At 9 years old and 80 pounds, Christmas Tree is a beautiful Bloodhound mix with a heart as big as her paws. And if you're looking for a dog who has mastered the art of taking it easy, you've found her! She's an incredibly easygoing, calm, and laid-back girl who is perfectly happy lounging around and enjoying the good life.

But don't let her couch-potato status fool you—mention the word WALK and suddenly Christmas Tree is ready to clock in! She loves getting outside, walks beautifully on leash, and is always happy to hop in the car for a ride. She's also house trained, travels well, and knows "come."

Christmas Tree enjoys being pet and will happily hang out with her people, though she's not necessarily demanding constant cuddles. She's not particularly interested in toys and can be a little selective about her treats, but honestly, who needs toys when you have walks and a comfy place to nap?

She's wonderful with dogs, adults, men, women, and elderly people, and her foster describes her as having no aggression and no concerning behaviors. She doesn't resource guard and is generally a very chill girl. Cats are currently untested. She does bark at the vacuum cleaner and was startled by a school bus, but otherwise she's pretty unfazed by the world around her.

Christmas Tree isn't looking for a complicated life. She just wants a comfortable home, some good walks, a soft place to land, and people who will love her for the rest of her life. After losing the home she knew through absolutely no fault of her own, she deserves to know that her next home will be forever.

If you would like to adopt this dog, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
